facts.name: Ascent Peachtree
facts.address: 161 Peachtree Center Ave NE | Atlanta, GA 30303
facts.specials: HALF OFF BASE RENT FOR THE FIRST 5 MONTHS! Base rent on select homes. Minimum term and restrictions apply. Fees excluded.

fees.deposit: Holding Deposit (Refundable) $250.00, Security Deposit - Additional (Refundable) Varies
fees.other: Access Device $75.00 - $100.00 (One-Time / Move-In), Package Services $25.00 (Monthly), Renters Liability Insurance - Third Party Varies (Monthly, Required), Utility - Final Bill Fee $20.00 (One-Time / Move-Out), Utility - New Account Fee $20.00 (One-Time / Move-In)

facts.utilities: Common Area - Electric (Usage-Based), Common Area - Gas ($15.00 Monthly), Internet Services ($70.00 Monthly), Pest Control Services ($6.00 Monthly), Trash Services - Hauling ($30.00 Monthly), Utility - Billing Administrative Fee ($7.00 Monthly), Utility - Electric - Third Party (Usage-Based), Utility - Gas (Usage-Based). Resident may need to activate and maintain utility services, including but not limited to electricity, water, gas, and internet, per the lease.
facts.pet_policy: Pet Fee $300.00 (One-Time / Move-In), Pet Management - Third Party $28.00 (Per-Lease), Pet Mgmt - Additional Pet - Third Party $24.00 (Per-Lease), Pet Rent $25.00 (Per Pet Monthly).
facts.parking: Parking $100.00 - $150.00 (Per Vehicle Monthly Optional), Parking - EV (Varies), Parking - Reserved $200.00 (Monthly Optional).

facts.notes: New 'Smart' Apartment, Penthouse & Townhome Residences. Experience elevated living with ApproveShield Advanced Screening.
